Chimes - the ice cream app

Your customers know you're on the way.

Drive into their area and they get a chime with your name. You don't send a thing.

Put my van on the map See how it works

Your van, on their phone.

No posts, no messages to send. Customers pick their own area and Chimes tells them when you arrive.

    Then lock your phone and drive.

See Chimes in action

Forty seconds: the map, a van on its way, and the chime your customers hear. Turn the sound on.

Get your van on Chimes

Tell us about your business and we'll set you up within 24 hours.

Or do it yourself: get Chimes on your iPhone, then Settings → Register your business. You sign in with a code we email you.

Register your business Ask us a question
  • Free listing: your pin on the map, with what you sell.
  • Live van tracking: start free in demo mode, then the Chimes team switches you to fully live. Customers follow your van, marked Live.
  • Your call: tap Stop Sharing or use our auto-hide features and customers stop seeing where you are.

Looking for ice cream?

Get a chime when the van's nearby.

Always free for ice cream fans. No account. iPhone, iPad and Android.

  1. 1

    Pick your area

    A postcode and a radius.

  2. 2

    A van comes near, your phone chimes

    With the van's name and what they sell, app open or not.

  3. 3

    Go get your ice cream!

    Tap the van for directions, plus its Facebook, Instagram, website and email.

More in the app

  • Keep your favourites

    Grouped by area. Even ones not on Chimes yet.

  • Filter the map

    Just the Live vans, or just your favourites.

No vans near you yet?

Chimes is new. Help it grow where you live.

  • Tell your local van

    Next time you buy a 99, send them to chimesapp.com/register. A free listing takes minutes.

  • Tell us about a van

    Send us its name and town and we'll get in touch with them.

  • Share Chimes

    The more people nearby use Chimes, the more reason a van has to join. On iPhone: Settings → Share Chimes.
